responsibility: Connects host POSIX signal handling to GNU Modula-2 runtime exception dispatch. It stores callback procedures for Modula-2 exception categories, installs SIGBUS, SIGSEGV, and SIGFPE sigaction handlers, and maps signal codes and fault addresses to the registered runtime handlers for invalid-location, divide-by-zero, overflow, and related language exceptions; on systems without signal support it degrades to a stub initializer.
